XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Engine fuel supply

  • Device: Fuel pressure regulator

  • Fault: The vehicle occasionally exhibits significantly poor performance; during acceleration, an engine system fault warning appears on the instrument panel and, occasionally, the engine stops suddenly. After restarting, the vehicle temporarily returns to normal operation.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P1180 (Fuel supply system, low-pressure circuit – Fuel line/fuel filter)

  • Cause: Faulty fuel pressure regulator

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the fuel pressure regulator and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The regulator is located in the engine compartment on the driver’s side and is attached to the high-pressure fuel pump. To access it, the air filter box must be removed. The estimated time for the procedure is approximately 1.17 hours.
